```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)
library(knitr)
library(fs)

# Percorso principale dove sono salvati i file RDS
data_dir <- "/projects/shared/cellxgene_split_by_dataset"

# Scansione di tutti i file di output
rds_files <- dir_ls(data_dir, recurse = TRUE, glob = "*_qc_metrics.rds")

cat("Numero di file RDS trovati:", length(rds_files), "\n")
```

```{r load-data}
# 1. Caricamento file RDS
all_results <- map(rds_files, readRDS)

# 2. Aggregazione Summary Globale (summary è già un dataframe)
df_summary <- map_dfr(all_results, ~ .x$summary)

# 3. Aggregazione Bias Tipi Cellulari
df_celltypes <- map_dfr(all_results, function(x) {
  if (is.null(x$celltype_bias) || NROW(x$celltype_bias) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  as.data.frame(x$celltype_bias) %>%
    mutate(
      Tissue = x$summary$Tissue,
      Dataset_ID = x$summary$Dataset_ID
    )
})

# 4. Aggregazione Statistiche MALAT1 (convertito in data.frame a 1 riga)
df_malat1 <- map_dfr(all_results, function(x) {
  ms <- x$malat1_stats
  if (is.null(ms) || length(ms) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  as.data.frame(as.list(ms)) %>%
    mutate(
      Tissue = x$summary$Tissue,
      Dataset_ID = x$summary$Dataset_ID,
      .before = 1
    )
})

# 5. Aggregazione Statistiche EmptyDrops (uso di NROW per gestire vettori e matrici)
df_emptydrops <- map_dfr(all_results, function(x) {
  has_ed <- !is.null(x$emptydrops_res) && length(x$emptydrops_res) > 0
  
  # NROW restituisce la lunghezza se è un vettore, o il numero di righe se è una matrice/df
  n_tested <- if (has_ed) NROW(x$emptydrops_res) else NA_integer_
  
  tibble(
    Tissue         = x$summary$Tissue,
    Dataset_ID     = x$summary$Dataset_ID,
    EmptyDrops_Ran = has_ed,
    Pass_Pct       = ifelse(is.null(x$summary$EmptyDrops_Pass_Pct), NA, x$summary$EmptyDrops_Pass_Pct),
    Total_Tested   = n_tested
  )
})
```

# 1. Panoramica Generale (Global Metrics)

```{r global-overview}
global_stats <- df_summary %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Datasets = n(),
    Total_Tissues = n_distinct(Tissue),
    Total_Cells = sum(Total_Cells, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Kept_Cells = sum(Kept_Cells, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_Discarded_Cells = sum(Discarded_Cells, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Kept_Pct = round(mean(Kept_Pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Median_Kept_Pct = round(median(Kept_Pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  )

kable(global_stats, caption = "Statistiche Generali dell'intero Dataset")
```

---

# 2. Sintesi per Tessuto (Tissue Summary)

```{r tissue-summary}
tissue_summary <- df_summary %>%
  group_by(Tissue) %>%
  summarise(
    N_Datasets = n(),
    Total_Cells = sum(Total_Cells, na.rm = TRUE),
    Kept_Cells = sum(Kept_Cells, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Kept_Pct = round(mean(Kept_Pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Mean_MT_Thresh = round(mean(MT_Threshold, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    Median_UMI = median(Median_UMI, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Cells))

datatable(
  tissue_summary,
  options = list(pageLength = 15, autoWidth = TRUE),
  caption = "Aggregazione Metriche QC divise per Tessuto"
)
```

---

# 3. Dettaglio Metriche per Singolo Dataset

```{r dataset-table}
datatable(
  df_summary,
  filter = "top",
  extensions = 'Buttons',
  options = list(
    pageLength = 10,
    dom = 'Bfrtip',
    buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel')
  ),
  caption = "Tabella Interattiva: Metriche QC per ogni Dataset"
)
```

---

# 4. Bias sui Tipi Cellulari (Cell Type Bias)

```{r celltype-bias}
celltype_summary <- df_celltypes %>%
  group_by(CellType, Tissue) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cells = sum(Total, na.rm = TRUE),
    Kept_Cells = sum(Kept, na.rm = TRUE),
    Discarded_Cells = sum(Discarded, na.rm = TRUE),
    Overall_Kept_Pct = round((Kept_Cells / Total_Cells) * 100, 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(Total_Cells > 100) %>%
  arrange(Overall_Kept_Pct)

datatable(
  celltype_summary,
  filter = "top",
  options = list(pageLength = 15, autoWidth = TRUE),
  caption = "Tassi di Ritenzione per Tipo Cellulare, Tessuto e Dataset (> 100 cellule)"
)
```

---

# 5. Monitoraggio Espressione MALAT1

```{r malat1-summary}
if (ncol(df_malat1) > 2) {
  datatable(
    df_malat1,
    filter = "top",
    options = list(pageLength = 10),
    caption = "Distribuzione dei Conteggi del Gene MALAT1"
  )
} else {
  cat("Nessun dato MALAT1 trovato nei dataset.")
}
```

---

# 6. Stato di Esecuzione EmptyDrops

```{r emptydrops-summary}
emptydrops_overview <- df_emptydrops %>%
  group_by(Tissue) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Datasets = n(),
    Datasets_with_EmptyDrops = sum(EmptyDrops_Ran),
    Mean_Pass_Pct = round(mean(Pass_Pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  )

kable(emptydrops_overview, caption = "Riepilogo Esecuzione EmptyDrops per Tessuto")
```
